text:
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance inspection 
I3, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title 
block
This procedure was applied in 
Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976,The generator data: 81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, 
PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection .
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.Samir 
Ouf Hassoub , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence (rope) 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, gloves ... etc.
Gas turbine out of 
 service at cold state.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete tool set
New brushes, Air blower, 
 and Spray
Digital voltmeter, megger , 
 clamp ammeter
Fine cloth and brushes 
 for cleaning purposes
Work to be carried out
Rotor
Measure insulation resistance
Exciter set
Overhaul commutators (undercutting of mica if 
required)
Inspect magnet frame and armature winding and 
clearing if required
Inspect brush holders
Clean frames
Check brush assembly and adjustment of 
neutral axis
Measure insulation resistance
Overhaul commutators (undercutting of mica if 
required)
Inspect magnet frame and armature winding and 
clearing if required
Inspect brush holders
Clean frames
Check brush assembly and adjustment of 
neutral axis
Coolers
Check vents .
Hydrogen System
Check gas consumption .
Inspect dry type filters and cleaning if 
 required .
Seal oil supply system
Check pressure gauge step valves

contact setting
